fingerprint.selection_reason: The evidence is metric-rich and led by a documented global search-traffic decline, alongside survey measures of priorities, assessments, and expectations.

key_insights: Chartbeat aggregate data sourced for the report show Google traffic from organic search to more than 2,500 sites fell 33% globally between November 2024 and November 2025. Separately, the average slider score among Q5 respondents (base 268; slider range +100% to −100%) was −43% for expected search-engine traffic change over the next three years, an expectation rather than an observed change.

Among the 264 Q13 respondents, the reported net difference between proportions saying areas were more versus less important for newsroom focus in the era of AI was +91 for original investigations/on-the-ground reporting, +82 for contextual analysis (explanation, framing), and −42 for service journalism.
source_note: Source: Reuters Institute — Trends and Predictions 2026
title: JANUARY 2026
tldr_compact: Google organic-search traffic to more than 2,500 sites fell 33% globally from November 2024 to November 2025.
tldr_standard: Chartbeat aggregate data show Google traffic from organic search to more than 2,500 sites fell 33% globally from November 2024 to November 2025.
